title: NEURONIX Vital Observation Contract Schema
description: Laboratory-grade machine observation contract for Vital telemetry records. Enforces telemetry classification, explicit nulls for unexposed sensors, and provenance tracking.

telemetry_class.description: Telemetry classification separating raw machine observation from derived computation and diagnostic reasoning.

value.description: The observed or derived value. Must be null if availability is not AVAILABLE.

unit.description: Physical or logical unit of measurement (e.g. celsius, percent, bytes, mhz, load, count, enum, string).

observed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of observation collection.

monotonic_at.description: Monotonic clock value in nanoseconds at the time of observation.

source.description: Kernel, hardware, or sysfs subsystem providing the observation (e.g. hwmon, /proc/loadavg, statvfs:/).

freshness_ms.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since the observation was sampled.

quality.description: Assessment of data currency and sensor liveness.

confidence.description: Statistical or deterministic confidence score (1.0 for direct hardware measurement).

provenance.description: Cryptographic or subsystem origin identifier establishing data lineage.

availability.description: Sensor exposure and availability status. Mandates null value when UNAVAILABLE.

reason.description: Optional explanation for unavailable, restricted, or degraded sensors.
